`1x1.png` is a hand-built PNG with one compressed RGBA pixel; `huge-dimensions.png` is a hand-built valid PNG IHDR declaring 100000×100000, with no image data; `three-frames.gif` is a hand-built GIF89a with three image descriptors; `1x1.webp` is a hand-built RIFF/WEBP VP8L header declaring a 1×1 image; `ftyp-isom.mp4` is a hand-built `ftyp` box with major brand `isom` and compatible-brand padding; `minimal.webm` is a hand-built EBML header with DocType `webm`; `image.svg` is a literal SVG document; `playlist.m3u8` is a literal HLS playlist.
